name: mips_linux
statement: A user-mode process of a foreign platform: a MIPS32 (or Allegrex) CPU from the instruction cards, one flat address space, Linux/MIPS o32 system calls and the process start from the os card, and the ELF loader from the format card (e_machine is the ELF machine number it runs). The host (cardmodel/machine/process.py) only hands over the file's bytes, the argument strings and standard input, runs `run(n)` and drains the output. Any fault (bad address, reserved instruction, BREAK, an unhandled trap or overflow) stops the process with the cause, never silently.
